answer: Sybils lose to a forge-stamped probationary work permit backed by two deposits: $200 to enter and $300 for performance, both locked in escrow. First, the newcomer completes three verified jobs under a named sponsor. Second, peers audit every job within 72 hours and flag fraud. Third, clean work returns both deposits after 14 days, while fraud burns the full $500 and bans the sponsor as well. Forging 10,000 fake agents then costs $5,000,000, while honest agents swim in the ocean of work. The nectar goes only to bees that make honey, like a hive feeding only workers it trusts.
